name: shva
description: Shiva Kakkar's personal Claude Code plugins. Cross-cutting tools that aren't tied to any single product — vocabulary briefings, prompt scaffolds, LinkedIn authoring with Shiva's voice, and personal workflow accelerators.

plugins.name: shva
plugins.description: Personal command + skill pack. v0.1.0 shipped /shva:brief-me — a domain-agnostic pre-project vocabulary briefing that returns a 20-25 term glossary (Creative/Style · Technical/Process · Prompt/Direction) before any GenAI build (code, design, video, music, art); forces vocabulary alignment between user and AI before instructions are given, reducing drift and hallucination; ships with the 'flag terms I'm using incorrectly' coda that turns Claude into a real-time vocabulary coach. v0.3.0 adds /shva:shva-linkedin-post-writer — write LinkedIn posts in Dr. Shiva Kakkar's distinctive systems-thinker voice using three signature lenses (Sequence Inversion, Constraint Migration, Authority Redesign), six-tier MCP source hierarchy (his Readwise/Voicenotes/Plaud/Gemini-files/LlamaCloud first, web as support last), Hook Test + Cringe Test gates, kostja mechanics clash table, and a god-mode pipeline that handles post + visual + LinkedIn publish protocol + self-learning JSONL loop + Wiki Save + Taste Capture into the Obsidian LLM wiki. v0.4.0 adds the Medium duo: /shva:shva-medium-writer drafts a 1500-2000 word Medium-grade essay in Shiva's voice for shivakakkar.com (7-beat long-form template, Astro frontmatter, SEO/AI-SEO co-citation rules — ≥3 tier-1 institutional names co-located with Rehearsal/Gradeless, ≥5 quotable standalone sentences, v1.0 bio footer); /shva:shva-medium-poster publishes the deployed essay to Medium under 'Built at Rehearsal' via Chrome automation (state machine over import → cleanup → tags → submit-for-review, cache-staleness sentinel detection, full failure-recovery playbook from the 4-essay 2026-05-12 session). v0.5.0 promotes the LinkedIn anti-staccato cadence rule and the explicit LinkedIn MCP confirmation step. v0.6.0 adds /shva:worksheet-generator, which turns a topic plus rough ideas into an AI-resistant, self-contained, print-ready teaching worksheet (HTML first for review, then a ReportLab PDF) in Shiva's voice. It runs a 7-stage pipeline: AskUserQuestion intake, parallel deep research across LlamaCloud, the Obsidian wiki, Readwise, YouTube, book-search, and Mobbin design taste, a carried-forward content arc with one worked example threaded through, the hard formatting rules (no author names, no em or en dashes, plain language, proportional boxes, contextual Be Mindful panels, real signing space), an HTML house-style template with a render-and-eyeball verify loop, and a ReportLab print build. It bundles the aesthetic-pdf-creator guide, the worked DHRL builder, the HTML template, a banned-string lint, and a render-check script. v0.7.0 adds /shva:teaching-designer, the facilitator-facing sibling of the worksheet generator. It turns a teaching brief into a light, discussion-led executive keynote and an aesthetic interactive HTML doc (lesson plan plus click-to-expand spoken script). Pipeline: AskUserQuestion discovery; parallel research across the Obsidian wiki, LlamaCloud, Readwise, YouTube, book-search, and parallel research subagents, with provenance labels (verbatim, paraphrase, synthesis) and mandatory caveats; the scaled-spine arc (one contrarian idea traced across Individual, Team, and Organization) with a single running thread and a wrapper analogy opened cold and closed at higher resolution; a memorable named principle per section plus an end revision recap with an Apply action each; micro-exercises (the JD rewrite and the Jesuthasan task decomposition tagging tasks execution, augment, or decision); evidence cards with real citations held against caveats; before and after Mermaid diagrams validated before embedding; and a collapsible color-coded HTML house style (Teaching, Evidence, Discussion, Exercise, Video) with distinctive fonts, a warm palette, expand-all, print-friendly output, and a render-check script. Validated on the XLRI Not Deeper Wider session. v0.7.1 syncs the /shva:help screen and the plugin and marketplace READMEs across all surfaces for the worksheet-generator and teaching-designer skills. v0.7.2 promotes teaching-designer's lead pedagogy law, anticipation over revelation (Shiva's signature): never put the answer on the slide; pose the question, hand the room thinking lenses, hold every reveal until earned; diagnose before data; question titles over assertions; thinking principles not model answers in exercises; cut any slide that over-explains. v0.8.0 adds three personal workflow skills, each promoted from a matured Obsidian wiki method. /shva:genai-use-case-finder turns a function, org, industry, or process into a FILLED, prioritized GenAI use-case portfolio for a real organization by running Shiva's four-move method (MAP dual-lens discovery for point versus system, GATE the five-question independence tell, SCORE on value by feasibility with risk as a veto and verifiability as the autonomy axis, SEQUENCE into named quadrants of Lighthouses, Strategic Bets, Quick Wins, Park or Kill); it is an analysis generator for a real org, distinct from the teaching siblings. /shva:mdp-source-finder assembles a curated source pack for an MDP, FDP, or executive workshop indexed by session beat (hands-on lab, opening hook, case study, live demo, pre-read, course scaffold to borrow), querying Raindrop and the wiki live rather than echoing a frozen list, then handing off to teaching-designer. /shva:persona-profile-from-text builds an evidence-anchored, quote-grounded profile of a person from their own text (voice notes, journals, transcripts, posts, uploads) in two modes (Rehearsal mirror mode for engagement, B2B voice-harvest mode for outreach), using validated frameworks as a reasoning lens but never printing trait scores or type codes, surfacing surprises as questions not verdicts, extracting by source type over an append-only signal log, and gating on a higher consent tier.
